WHAT PEOPLE ACTUALLY NEED

From a difficult story to a reviewable record.

Most people do not arrive with a neat legal issue. They arrive with events, documents, urgency and uncertainty. CasePath prepares that raw material for professional review.

CONTEXT-PRESERVING LEGAL PREPARATION

One matter. Four planes that never collapse.

The architecture preserves the user’s source material while progressively organising it for legal review. An account does not become evidence, evidence does not become a legal conclusion, and a legal possibility does not become an authorised action.

01
Source plane

Preserve the user’s expression, dates, people, records and requested outcomes without silently rewriting them.

02
Evidence plane

Link propositions to supporting, contradicting and missing material while retaining provenance and uncertainty.

03
Legal plane

Present possible legal lenses and current official sources conditionally; application remains for the qualified lawyer.

04
Action plane

Prepare pathway questions, document drafts and a lawyer handover without filing, representing or promising an outcome.

MANDATORY PAGE IN EVERY DELIVERY

One package. Three distinct perspectives.

The first substantive page tells the user exactly what each artifact is, who created it, what authority it has, and how it may be used. Conditional analysis never masquerades as settled law.

01
Your lawyer might, could or would say

Possible questions, professional considerations and necessary review steps—never invented advice or a promised view.

THE LINE WE DO NOT CROSS

Software can prepare the record. A lawyer must assess the law.

Clear boundaries make the pack more useful. CasePath labels what came from you, what is supported by a record, what remains unverified and what requires professional judgment.

01

No solicitor–client relationship
Using this site does not retain a lawyer or create legal professional privilege.

02

No legal conclusion
A polished document is not proof that a fact, claim, defence, remedy or amount is legally valid.

03

No filing authority
Nothing is sent to a court, tribunal, police agency, opponent or lawyer by CasePath.

04

No deadline assurance
Urgent time limits can apply. Verify them immediately with a lawyer or the relevant official body.
